asset_bounds.name: asset_bounds

content_ownership.name: content_ownership
content_ownership.value: ("content_packs"."owner_type"='ruckus' and "content_packs"."workspace_id" is null and "content_packs"."visibility"='built_in' and "content_packs"."system_slug" is not null and "content_packs"."created_by_user_id" is null) or ("content_packs"."owner_type"='workspace' and "content_packs"."workspace_id" is not null and "content_packs"."visibility"='workspace_private' and "content_packs"."system_slug" is null and "content_packs"."created_by_user_id" is not null)

session_participant_bounds.name: session_participant_bounds
session_participant_bounds.value: "session_participants"."avatar" between 0 and 19 and ("session_participants"."final_rank" is null or "session_participants"."final_rank">0) and ("session_participants"."final_score" is null or "session_participants"."final_score">=0) and "session_participants"."segments_completed" between 0 and "session_participants"."segments_participated" and "session_participants"."segments_participated" between 0 and 50

session_bounds_check.name: session_bounds_check
session_bounds_check.value: "session_runs"."ended_at">="session_runs"."started_at" and "session_runs"."duration_seconds" between 0 and 1000000 and "session_runs"."player_count_joined">="session_runs"."player_count_completed" and "session_runs"."player_count_completed">=0 and "session_runs"."player_count_joined">=0 and "session_runs"."demo_count" between 0 and "session_runs"."player_count_joined" and "session_runs"."details_omitted" between 0 and "session_runs"."player_count_joined" and "session_runs"."segment_count" between 1 and 50 and "session_runs"."launch_snapshot_version"=1

session_segment_bounds.name: session_segment_bounds
session_segment_bounds.value: "session_segments"."sequence_index" between 0 and 49 and "session_segments"."segment_type" in ('original','studio') and "session_segments"."ended_at">="session_segments"."started_at" and "session_segments"."duration_seconds">=0 and "session_segments"."rounds">0 and "session_segments"."participant_count" between 0 and 300 and "session_segments"."submissions">=0 and "session_segments"."votes">=0 and jsonb_array_length("session_segments"."results")<=300
